description: Title card 16:9: title in Neuborn as written (e.g. "jensen x mark tremonti") with RGB split, optionally "LOUD SOCIETY PRESENTS" above; on black (H.264) or transparent over footage (alpha). Glitch-in 0.4 s, glitch-out 0.2 s, 1.5–8 s.

parameters.title: Title text, up to 40 characters
parameters.presents: true: "LOUD SOCIETY PRESENTS" above the title (default false)
